summary: Keep malformed hidden native blocks out of shared prose, reject malformed block collections, preserve body-reference status and retryable errors, and retain assistant facts from final tool-call and error owner blocks.

schema.detail: No wire or storage schema change.

compatibility.detail: Present non-array native blocks are rejected rather than treated as legacy prose. Missing blocks retain legacy behavior. Hidden dropped blocks preserve mixed-content suppression; native status/error bodies and final assistant owner facts retain their decoded semantics. Tool-result metadata is not assistant usage.
